# Tracking Guru

> Google Ads management with full conversion tracking across every ad
> platform a business runs, for local service businesses and B2B companies
> in the United Kingdom, United States, and Canada.

## What we do

Tracking Guru sets up and manages Google Ads campaigns, and builds the
conversion tracking behind them and behind any other platform a client
advertises on: Google tag and GA4 event tracking, Enhanced Conversions for
Leads, Meta Pixel and Conversions API with event deduplication, TikTok and
Pinterest conversion tracking, server-side tagging (server-side GTM,
typically hosted on Stape.io), and offline conversion imports that connect
a CRM-closed deal back to the ad click that originally drove it. Meta,
TikTok, and Pinterest ad campaigns are not managed directly, only tracked.

## Who we serve

Local service businesses (HVAC, plumbing, home services) and B2B
companies (professional and managed services), plus law firms and medical
aesthetics practices, operating in the UK, US, and Canada.
